source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Topic 5.1 (PDF 127, printed 124).

blocks.text: Model building ka matlab hai kisi complex (uljhe hue) masle ki ek saada shakal (simplified representation) banana. Is mein sirf aham hisson (key elements) par tawajjo di jati hai. Is se asal zindagi ke masail ko samajhna, un ka jaiza lena (analyze karna) aur unhein hal karna aasan ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Model kya chhor deta hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Model ghair zaroori tafseel (unnecessary details) chhor deta hai, ta ke tawajjo masle ke sab se aham hisson par rahe.

items: Model building: complex masle ki saada shakal banana jis mein sirf aham hisse rakhe jate hain.
